notes: AT HOP or contactless; ferries are run by Fullers (Waiheke and Rangitoto need separate tickets). The SkyDrive airport bus takes 45 minutes. For Piha and Hobbiton, hire a car or join a tour (drive on the left).
NOTE: June to September is winter in New Zealand (10-15°C, rain, short days); trails are muddy and Waiheke is quiet. Matariki (Māori New Year) is a holiday in June or July.
NZeTA and IVL tourist levy are paid online; Turkish citizens need a visa (check). Coffee costs 5-6 NZD, a café meal 25, a tour 250; tipping is not expected.
Book Hobbiton online weeks ahead; no photography at Waitomo; no water or shops on Rangitoto; Piha's currents can be deadly, so stay between the flags.
See Māori culture at the museum's haka show; 'kia ora' is a greeting. Try fish and chips, a flat white and hokey pokey ice cream.
UV is very high (thin ozone); in summer you can burn in 15 minutes.

transit.name: AT HOP / contactless
transit.why_chosen: Buses, trains and ferries, except the Devonport and Waiheke ferries. A contactless bank card also works.
transit.where_to_buy: Kendi temassız kartın veya AT HOP 5 NZD

stops.name: Sky Tower
stops.tips: At 328 m, the tallest tower in the Southern Hemisphere. Glass floor; SkyWalk and SkyJump cost extra. Buy tickets online.

stops.name: Auckland Art Gallery
stops.tips: Māori and Pacific art under a kauri timber roof. Free entry (20 NZD for foreign visitors).

stops.name: Albert Park & University
stops.tips: A Victorian park with a floral clock.

stops.name: Depot Eatery Federal Street
stops.tips: Al Brown's oyster and seafood bar, right below the Sky Tower.

stops.name: Viaduct Harbour & Wynyard Quarter
stops.tips: Marina with America's Cup yachts. Visit Silo Park and the Maritime Museum (25 NZD).

backups.name: Auckland Fish Market Wynyard
backups.tips: Fish market food hall; try the fish and chips.

backups.name: New Zealand Maritime Museum
backups.tips: From Polynesian canoes to yachts; harbour boat tour available.

stops.name: Waiheke Ferry Fullers
stops.tips: 40 minutes from Downtown (return about 60 NZD) across the Hauraki Gulf.

stops.name: Oneroa Beach & Village
stops.tips: The main village and beach, with galleries and swimming in summer.

stops.name: Mudbrick Vineyard
stops.tips: Vineyard and restaurant with city views. Try the syrah tasting; book ahead.

stops.name: Cable Bay Vineyards
stops.tips: Neighbouring vineyard with a terrace; wine and cheese platter.

stops.name: Onetangi Beach
stops.tips: The island's longest beach. Take the bus; catch the 17:30 ferry before sunset.

backups.name: Man O' War Vineyard
backups.tips: Beachside vineyard at the island's far end; taxi or car needed.

backups.name: Waiheke EcoZip
backups.tips: Zipline with forest and sea views; an alternative to wine tasting.

stops.name: Mount Eden
stops.tips: A 196 m volcanic crater with 360° views of the city and Sky Tower. Best in morning light.

stops.name: Auckland War Memorial Museum
stops.tips: Māori hall (war canoe, marae), haka show (extra) and volcano gallery. Set in the Domain park.

stops.name: Devonport Ferry
stops.tips: A 12-minute crossing to a Victorian-era town.

stops.name: Mount Victoria Devonport
stops.tips: Short climb with views of the city skyline, Rangitoto opposite and old barracks guns.

stops.name: Devonport Chocolates & Waterfront
stops.tips: The town's main street for chocolate, then Cheltenham Beach.

backups.name: Wintergarden Domain
backups.tips: Glasshouses next to the museum; free.

stops.name: Arataki Visitor Centre
stops.tips: Gateway to the Waitākere forest (45 minutes by car). Māori carvings and views.

stops.name: Kitekite Falls
stops.tips: A 40 m waterfall; easy 1-hour return walk, with a swimming pool at the base.

stops.name: Piha Beach & Lion Rock
stops.tips: Wild black-sand surf beach. Climb Lion Rock and swim only between the flags (currents are dangerous).

stops.name: Piha Cafe
stops.tips: Beach café for fish and coffee.

stops.name: Karekare Beach
stops.tips: The beach from the film The Piano; waterfall, and usually empty.

backups.name: Muriwai Gannet Colony
backups.tips: Gannet colony (August to March); an alternative to Karekare.

backups.name: Elevation Café Waitakere
backups.tips: Café with views over Scenic Drive.

stops.name: Hobbiton Movie Set
stops.tips: 2.5 hours to Matamata (tour about 250 NZD from Auckland). 44 hobbit holes, beer included at the Green Dragon. Book online weeks ahead.

stops.name: Matamata Lunch
stops.tips: Town café; try a pie.

stops.name: Waitomo Glowworm Caves
stops.tips: Glowworm cave reached by a silent boat ride. No photography; Ruakuri costs extra.

stops.name: Waitomo Caves Village
stops.tips: Short break; the drive back takes 3 hours.

backups.name: Ruakuri Cave
backups.tips: Cave with a spiral entrance; photography allowed. An alternative to Glowworm Caves.

backups.name: Huhu Cafe Waitomo
backups.tips: The best café in the caves town.

stops.name: Rangitoto Island Ferry
stops.tips: 25-minute Fullers ferry to a 600-year-old volcanic island.

stops.name: Rangitoto Summit Track
stops.tips: 1-hour, 260 m climb past lava caves and the crater, through the world's largest pohutukawa forest. Bring water (no shops).

stops.name: Rangitoto Wharf Return
stops.tips: Ferries at 12:45 and 15:30 back to the city.

stops.name: Ponsonby Road
stops.tips: Boutiques and cafés, plus the Ponsonby Central food courtyard.

stops.name: Ponsonby Central
stops.tips: Food market; try Bird on a Wire chicken and El Sizzling Chorizo.

backups.name: Tiritiri Matangi Island
backups.tips: Bird sanctuary island (takahe, kokako). Ferries Wednesday to Sunday; an alternative to Rangitoto.

stops.name: Tamaki Drive Walk
stops.tips: Waterfront road with views of Okahu Bay and Rangitoto.

stops.name: Mission Bay Beach
stops.tips: City beach with a fountain; Kelly Tarlton's aquarium is nearby.

stops.name: Mission Bay Breakfast
stops.tips: Cafés opposite the beach; a farewell eggs benedict.

stops.name: Britomart SkyDrive
stops.tips: SkyDrive airport bus, 45 minutes; time to say goodbye.

backups.name: Kelly Tarlton's Sea Life
backups.tips: Penguins and a shark tunnel; an alternative to the beach.

backups.name: Giapo Ice Cream
backups.tips: Ice cream as art, on Gore Street.
